## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (cache-key, restore and path-handling changes must include an adversarial test)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or an ADR approves it)
- [ ] No shell invocation introduced
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Not a security issue (those go through SECURITY.md, never a public PR)
